title: Retire unsafe legacy provisioning entrypoints
scope: Replace three mutating legacy provisioners with unconditional literal refusal; retire unsafe recovery guidance in deploy diagnostics and existing runbook without changing deployment execution logic.
non_goals: No working desired-state reconciler, secret-name skip/merge fiction, initial-create/add-brand/rotation capability, migration/seed repair, resource/identity recovery, caller-shell startup security or full W08/finding/gate/customer/release acceptance.

No target provisioning/deploy/seed script execution, CLI/login/install/network/cloud/credential/customer-data/commit/push/cleanup, broad suite/framework or subdelegation. deploy.sh comments and literal diagnostic strings only. Runbook change limited to retirement/status/unsafe operative setup/auth advice.

criteria.description: All three provisioner bodies are fully replaced by one literal builtin printf to stderr plus exit2 only. No expansion, arguments, environment bypass, remote/local mutation, subprocess, surviving unsafe block or executable archive. Honest retirement message names pending W08, not successful provisioning.

All four shell files parse without execution. Actual deploy executable logic remains exactly unchanged excluding comments/diagnostics; changed diagnostics are literal and no longer recommend retired entrypoints, wildcard-key writes or AUTH_MODE=open recovery. Existing runbook withdraws operative safe/verified provisioning/auth advice and marks remaining legacy commands non-operative. Preserve unrelated work.

Independent exact before/final/pin/full-proof inspection and same source-only K1 once, inspecting worker scoped whitespace without rerun. Explicitly distinguish structural removal from executed script/remote-zero-call/working provisioning/customer isolation and release proof.

checks.runtime: Installed Node source assertions and /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -n with empty PATH; scripts parsed only, never invoked.
checks.workload: Exactly three literal refusal bodies, four shell syntax parses, unchanged deploy executable lines and narrow runbook guidance checks; worker scoped git diff --check five owned files. No runtime suite/compiler needed.

checks.command: Independent frozen W08.01 actual source/admission-diff/pins/full worker proof review and exact K1 once; record review.json.
checks.runtime: Independent source-only inspection plus same four syntax-only parses; no target script execution.
checks.workload: All C1-C3 and authority/residual coverage; inspect worker scoped whitespace without repeating it.
